title: Core concepts first: icon pages for every topic

message.text: Sent to content-ui, with your words verbatim. It builds a Concepts tile grid (icon + name, flex wrap, optional sectioned columns). Each concept becomes its own page (name, slug, icon, chat, rename). The first use is at the top of the System design card, and the rule goes into the content and page skills.

**Concepts tiles are live** on the System design card: [/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/system-design/](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/system-design/). Seven concept pages (Servex, Hooks, Restart and revival, Agents and roles, Tiers, The Dispatcher, Cards), in three sections drawn as columns. Module: [Concepts](/framework/ux/Content/Concepts/). One line in the content and page skills.

Two things for the AI 2 card view (not mine): the tiles draw BELOW the task list, not first; and each concept page also counts as a task ('7 to do'). Not merged or committed yet.
